subject: Certification coordination: inventory, gaps, and evidence asks
messages:
From: Acme Security <auditor@acme-sec.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO27001 / FedRAMP intake: initial scope and evidence asks

David —

Thanks for the quick intro. Our team is starting scoping for the upcoming ISO 27001 gap assessment and an early FedRAMP readiness check. To get the intake moving, can you point us to the following artifacts or owners: 

- Service & system boundary diagram (network/VPC, ingress/egress, third-party integrations).
- KMS key rotation policy and key metadata for production tenancy (who is the key custodian).
- Log retention evidence: S3 buckets or log archive policy showing retention windows + sample logs for 30d/90d/365d where applicable.
- SOC 2 overlap controls / control mapping (if you have a maturity or mapping doc that shows which controls are covered by which artifacts).
- CAIQ/SIG intake (if you have a working spreadsheet or partial responses, share the current column states).

Also: what is your preferred format for evidence ingestion (Drive folder, upload to portal, or zipped artifacts)? We typically request a small sample set first (3–5 artifacts per control family) and then schedule a dry run.

Requested timeline: kickoff week of 7/13, dry run week of 7/1 if possible.

If any of these items are already tracked in a central sheet, please share link and control owners so we can assign intake tasks on our side.

Cheers,
Lena Park
Senior Assessor | Acme Security
attachments: intake-form.pdf (see stub)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <auditor@acme-sec.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISO27001 / FedRAMP intake: initial scope and evidence asks

Thanks Lena — tagging the internal owners below.

Internal plan (high level):
- Priyom: lead on control inventory / CAIQ + SIG partials. Please export current CAIQ sheet and mark where we have "evidence ready" vs "needs owner".
- Olga: network/VPC diagram + (production) snapshot cadence, and list of infra owners.
- Kimberly: KMS/key rotation docs + attestation for rotation cadence.
- Marissa: logs + S3 retention inventory and sample log extracts.

Preferred evidence intake: Drive link (we'll create a secured folder and share view-only links per control family). For anything sensitive we can provide a one-time secure upload token — I'll coordinate with SecOps.

Tentative timeline:
- Share initial Drive folder and the control-map spreadsheet by EOD Wed (6/3).
- Internal triage sprint 6/4–6/10 to mark owners and collect first-pass artifacts.
- Deliver sample artifacts to Acme by 6/11 for their early review.

Lena — would you accept a two-hour kickoff on 6/12 to align scope and delivery? If not, propose alternatives.

-David
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Adding the current state from the inventory side — quick bullets and attachments.

- CAIQ/SIG: we have a living CAIQ spreadsheet that covers ~60% of questions pre-filled. I attached the control-map that maps CAIQ rows to our internal evidence buckets (see attachment: control-map-v1.xlsx).
- Logs: production API gateway + app logs are retained in s3://redwood-logs-prod for 90 days; long-term archival for 365d exists for billing and incident retention (separate bucket). I can pull one week of logs for the assessor as sample.
- KMS: rotation policy lives in Confluence (KMS Rotation SOP) and keys are tagged with owner=security-ops. Rotation is automated monthly for ephemeral keys and annually for master keys.
- Boundaries: our public API, model serving cluster, and feature-engine infra are in the production VPC (diagram in progress). Olga is pulling the network diagram and will include third-party endpoints (model registry, metrics ingest).

Attachments: control-map-v1.xlsx (control mapping + evidence pointers).

Next actions I can take this week: export CAIQ snapshot, export the sample logs (redact PII), and assemble a drive structure. Requesting owners to confirm by EOD 6/3.

— Priyom

Subject: Re: ISO27001 / FedRAMP intake: initial scope and evidence asks

David / Priyom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the control-map attachment — that helps. A few clarifying asks before we schedule the kickoff: 

1) Can you provide a sample S3 manifest or bucket policy that demonstrates retention enforcement for the 365d archive? Ideally we need a signed export or a screenshot of the bucket policy + sample object metadata.
2) For KMS, provide the key metadata CSV (key id, alias, rotation schedule, custodian email). If the keys are tagged, a small export from the cloud console is fine.
3) For FedRAMP scope: confirm whether the model registry and any hosted third-party inference endpoints are managed within the same VPC or are considered external (we need that boundary clarified for scoping).

We created a short intake form to help standardize submissions — link attached (intake-form.pdf). Please upload the initial samples to the Drive folder you create and share view-only links.

Audit timeline: kickoff week of 7/13 still looks good for our team. We will try to do a dry run the week of 7/1; if you can deliver the sample artifacts by 6/11 it gives us time to review and flag obvious gaps.

If useful, we can run a 30-minute pre-kick call on 6/12 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the intake form.

Best,
Lena Park
Senior Assessor | Acme Security
attachments: intake-form.pdf
